name: Landing page renders confidence dashboard
description: Verify the Confidence Engine landing page loads and shows the main dashboard elements before a session starts.

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait for the page to load
Assert that the heading 'Confidence Engine' is visible
Assert that the 'Start Session' button exists and is enabled
Assert that the 'End Session' button exists and is disabled
Assert that the 'Composite Score' gauge shows '--' before a session starts
Assert that the 'Real-Time Signals' panel lists signal rows for eye contact, blink rate, brow tension, smile, hand stability, fidgeting, hand openness, shoulder alignment, and posture
